notes: Read the line-numbered source before editing; every source line was considered. Header doc comment (L1-32) ported and adapted for native (Intl works in Hermes; locale fallback uses device Intl instead of navigator-only; notes that web Input + lib/currencyFormat deps are reproduced locally). Imports (L34-49) replaced: react hooks kept (forwardRef/useCallback/useEffect/useMemo/useRef/useState), web '@/components/ui' Input + '@/lib/currencyFormat' helpers reproduced locally as native-safe code, FocusEvent/KeyboardEvent DOM types swapped for RN NativeSyntheticEvent/TextInputFocusEventData/TextInputSubmitEditingEventData.

CurrencyInputChangePayload (L51-53) preserved verbatim. CurrencyInputProps (L55-81) preserved: valueMicro, onChange, currency, locale, precision, ariaLabel kept with their JSDoc; the Omit base swaps the HTML-input 'value|onChange|type|suffix|icon|defaultValue|aria-label' exclusions for the native equivalents 'value|onChange|onChangeText|suffix|icon|accessibilityLabel' against the local InputProps (TextInputProps-based).

Component doc (L83-91) preserved. forwardRef + destructure (L92-108) ported to forwardRef<TextInput, CurrencyInputProps>; onKeyDown destructure replaced by onSubmitEditing (the native Enter equivalent). effectiveLocale/effectivePrecision (L109-110), display/symbol memos (L112-119) and their deps preserved exactly. text useState (L121) and focusedRef (L123-127) preserved with identical names + comments. Added a textRef mirror of the controlled buffer because RN's blur/focus events are NativeSyntheticEvent<TargetedEvent> and do not carry the field text the way the web e.currentTarget.value did.

Resync effect (L132-135) preserved (skips setText while focused; also updates textRef). commit useCallback (L137-148) preserved verbatim incl. deps [onChange,currency,effectiveLocale,effectivePrecision] and the renormalise-on-commit behavior (now also syncing textRef). handleFocus (L150-156) preserved. handleBlur (L158-165) preserved: commits the latest buffered value via textRef.current then calls the user onBlur. handleKeyDown Enter-commit (L167-175) mapped to handleSubmitEditing via onSubmitEditing, committing textRef.current then calling the user handler. Web's inline onChange={e=>setText(e.target.value)} became onChangeText={handleChangeText} which updates both textRef and text. Handler param types are derived from TextInputProps (FieldFocusEvent/FieldBlurEvent/FieldSubmitEvent) so they always match RN's signatures.

Render (L177-201): web <Input type=text inputMode=decimal autoComplete=off aria-label value onChange onBlur onKeyDown onFocus icon> mapped to native <Input keyboardType=decimal-pad autoComplete=off autoCorrect=false autoCapitalize=none accessibilityLabel value onChangeText onBlur onSubmitEditing onFocus icon> with {...rest} spread preserved. The aria-hidden currency-symbol <span data-testid=currency-input-symbol> became an AppText with testID currency-input-symbol, muted tone, and accessibilityElementsHidden + importantForAccessibility='no-hide-descendants' to mirror aria-hidden. resolveLocale (L205-216) ported, adding an Intl device-locale fallback after the navigator.language check so it works on native (no DOM navigator).

Inlined native-safe port of the three consumed web '@/lib/currencyFormat' helpers (currencySymbol, formatCurrencyMicro, parseCurrencyTextToMicro) plus their internal deps (valueToMicro, microToValue, formatCurrencyValue, clampPrecision, normaliseLocale, stripCurrencyAdornments, parseLocaleNumber, parseCurrencyText). These are pure Intl.NumberFormat logic with no DOM, so behavior (micro-unit storage, locale separators, accounting parens, ISO-code stripping, invalid-code fallback) is identical. The web '@/components/ui' Input is reproduced as a local native-safe Input (label/icon/field/suffix/error/hint slots) over RN TextInput because neither dependency has its own native parity port yet; both reproductions are intentional and self-contained, mirroring the existing MetricCard parity precedent.

No DOM-only modules, HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, or web UI components are imported; only React, react-native primitives, the existing native AppText component, and theme tokens (colors/spacing/typography). Web density-only Input size 'auto' is intentionally not ported (native size = sm|md|lg, default md).
